model.architecture: two-tower (TFRS), in-batch softmax with logQ correction

evaluation.protocol: time split 70/10/20 by transaction timestamp; each test row = (user, basket minus one item) -> rank the held-out item among all products; items already in the basket are masked; ties count as misses
evaluation.data_note: transactions are synthetic (80% of picks drawn from 3-6 per-user favourites); users and catalogue come from the marketplace database
